responsibility: This module provides GCC’s native Windows GNU target support for MinGW and closely related PE/COFF environments, defining how the compiler, front ends, and backend adapt generic GCC behavior to the Win32/Win64 MS ABI and runtime model. Its option-definition files describe MinGW- and Cygming-specific command-line switches and their documentation metadata, while the central target headers establish driver specs, predefined macros, CRT and library selection, threading defaults, and target type properties such as fixed-width integer mappings. The main winnt sources implement Windows-specific backend behavior for PE/COFF symbol handling, section selection, dllimport/dllexport semantics, export recording, and SEH/unwind assembly emission, with companion code for rewriting imported symbol references through `__imp_` or refptr indirection during code generation. Language-facing support in the C-family, C++, and D hooks adds Microsoft-runtime format checking, C++ class-level import/export propagation, and D target-identification builtins, making this module the place where GCC’s generic compilation pipeline is specialized for MinGW’s Windows object format, DLL linkage rules, runtime selection, and diagnostics.
